tools.name: list_wikis
tools.description: List the live released kingy.wiki registry, game aliases, build caveats and separate search, structured-answer and authored-hint coverage counts. Supports pagination and an optional game name or slug.

tools.name: get_hint

The response contains only the requested tier, its source links and evidence limitations; an explicitly requested solution may also include clip moments for that solution. P
